_note: Nat_multitask_convnext_base_v4_decoupled: v3_uncalibrated plus three changes aimed at the crop->disease shortcut found in v3's head outputs. Uncalibrated, the v3 disease head scored 73.8% Top-1 on test_seen but 9.0% on test_unseen (median true-disease rank 17). 74% of its wrong unseen predictions were a disease paired with the TRUE crop in training (tomato_early_blight -> late_blight, grape_black_rot -> esca), and it predicted frequent diseases (mean train freq 195 vs 117 for the true ones). Changes: (1) Balanced Softmax on the disease head (fixed tau=1, training-time, nothing tuned); (2) same-disease cross-crop CutMix (p=0.5) so one disease is seen on two hosts under one label; (3) stochastic depth 0.1 and loss weights back to 1.0/1.0, since upweighting disease (v3) only strengthened the shortcut. Backbone uses the explicit 'timm:' prefix (same weights as v3) so drop_path_rate is applied. Gamma tuning stays disabled.
_result: Dropped vs v3_uncalibrated (gamma=0.0, epoch 6): test_seen top1 61.10% (crop 93.70%, disease 62.30%), test_unseen top1 0.90% (crop 78.25%, disease 4.70%), HM top1 1.77%, HM top5 36.41%, diagnostic unseen-only top1 87.15%.

data._note: Standard DPD evaluation on test_seen (2,000) and test_unseen (1,448) across all 333 composition pairs.

model._note: ConvNeXt-Base (ImageNet-22k -> 1k, timm) with dual linear heads (crop 55, disease 175), head dropout 0.2, stochastic depth 0.1 (new vs v3).

input._note: Unchanged from v3: 256 cache, 224 centre crop for evaluation.

augmentation._note: v3 augmentation plus same-disease cross-crop CutMix: with p=0.5 a box (area ~ Beta(1,1)) from a training image with the same disease but a different crop is pasted in. Disease label unchanged; crop label mixed by pasted area. Partners come only from the current fit frame, so pseudo-unseen validation pairs never leak.

loss._note: Equal task weights (v3 used crop 0.7 / disease 1.3). Balanced Softmax on the disease head: CE on logits + 1.0 * log class prior of the training frame, raw logits at inference. Counters the head's bias to frequent diseases; the unseen pairs' diseases are rare (aphis_spp 7, black_rot 36, anthracnose 51 train images). Crop head left as plain CE to isolate the effect.

optimizer._note: Unchanged from v3: AdamW, lr_backbone 5e-5, lr_head 5e-4, weight_decay 0.05.
optimizer.name: adamw

scheduler._note: Unchanged from v3: cosine, 2 warmup epochs, min_lr_ratio 0.01.
scheduler.name: cosine

validation._note: Unchanged from v3: gamma_grid 0 (uncalibrated selection), 3 pseudo-unseen splits of 20 holdout pairs.

training._note: Unchanged from v3. CutMix and drop-path regularise more, so max_epochs stays at 30 with patience 8 to allow a later best epoch.

evaluation._note: Standard DPD benchmark metrics: Top-1, Top-5, per-class means, and Harmonic Mean (HM).

runtime._note: AMP mixed precision on CUDA with 4 workers. Checkpointing every 5 epochs.
